notes: New in 2.3.6: two new skills. 1) It checks its own websites. After it builds or changes a site, it opens it in a hidden browser at phone size, looks at the picture, and fixes what looks wrong (text too small, things cut off, missing pictures). It can send you the picture too. 2) It makes videos, for free. It turns your photos, or pictures it makes, into a video with words on them (Hebrew and Yiddish work), a slow zoom, soft fades, and music or a voice. You get an MP4 that fits on WhatsApp. Each skill needs a one-time setup on your server. Run these once: sudo bash /opt/myassistant/current/optional/install-browser.sh (to check sites) and sudo bash /opt/myassistant/current/optional/install-video.sh (to make videos).
